note: Parameters are declared before the main grid runs. Only the cost-model shrink hs_mult=0.25 was set after an unshrunk Corwin-Schultz check showed median half-spreads of ~0.43% (implausible vs 1-2 ticks); it was fixed for all strategies and is stress-tested (0.5x/2x).

strategies.A0: naive Top50 (equal weight, buy rank<=50, sell when out of Top50; retained names not rebalanced) = P0 baseline_fixed state machine
strategies.A1: Top50 + hysteresis: buy rank<=50, held name kept while rank<=K_hold, target always exactly 50 names (kept names in best-rank order, remaining slots refilled by best-ranked NOT-held names)
strategies.A2: cost-aware long-only optimiser (own dual solver): alpha=beta_hat*z, beta_hat from matured labels only; diag 5d risk lam=25; turnover cost tau*side cost; cap per name; sum(w)<=1; optional |exposure|<=delta to log_amt20/vol20/r5; candidates top-100 by score + holdings

nested.scheme: expanding window, anchored at first signal; burn-in 52 periods (default params); test blocks of 26 periods (k=52..77, 78..103, 104..129, 130..155, 156..181, 182..206); for each block the parameter maximising net Sharpe (mean/std of per-period net return) over ALL periods before the block start is used; selection counterfactuals are parameter-fixed full runs, evaluation is a SCHEDULED run with actual state carry-over

C1_flat.cost: flat 0.30% round trip (0.15% per side, p0lib convention)

access_defaults: C1/C2: STAR(科创板) and BJ(北交所) allowed, exactly as in the P0 pool/baseline (needed for A0 to reconcile with P0); C3/C4: switches no_star/no_bj ON (conservative retail-account default), pcap=5% of prior-day ADV(20d median amount), min ADV 1e8 for candidates and buys

explicit_cost.spread: 0.25 x Corwin-Schultz 20d (half), floor half-tick/price, cap 2% full

cost_stress.where: HGB and LGBM, C2, A0/A1_nested/A2 selected schedules re-run with the same schedule

random_retention.description: R: each held name still in pool is kept with prob p regardless of rank; S (random skip): with prob q the naive Top50 is refreshed, else the portfolio is left untouched; p / q calibrated (bisection) so eval-period (k>=52) mean one-way turnover equals that of A1_nested / A2_nested; 20 seeds averaged

exploratory_flag: 2025-2026 is re-used data; every 2025-2026 number is exploratory, not a blind test. Nested selection never uses periods at or after the block start.
